svg.text: Emilia | frozen V3 first geometry test
BODY ONLY. One connected loft. Result unapproved. Frozen guide paths remain unchanged.
Outer width remains constrained near the arm graft.
Broad front band and lower pockets remain.
Upper planar turn interrupts the ribcage wrap.
Lower band and retained armpit pinch remain.
Projection landmarks track the registered guide.
Onset and lower join still read too distinctly.
MATCHES GUIDE: one surface; bounded side crest; no body intersections. Full shape match is not achieved.
Guide diagrams have no physical scale. 3/4 sketch and fixed camera face opposite ways; paths are not refitted.
